entities.summary: Henry Hollis Horton was an American attorney, farmer and politician who served as the 36th governor of Tennessee from 1927 to 1933. He was elevated to the position when Governor Austin Peay died in office, and as Speaker of the Tennessee Senate, he was first in the line of succession. He was subsequently elected to two more two-year terms.
